highlights: BFSI – NBFC 1 Gold Franchise Anchors Growth; Non-Gold Recovery Work in Progress Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: NII – BEAT; PPOP – BEAT; PAT – BEAT Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E/FY29E (in %): NII: 3.4/3.1/3.0; PPOP: 4.9/3.3/2.4; PAT: 1.2/-1.1/-2.6 Recommendation Rationale • Gold Loans Remain Core Growth Engine; Portfolio Increasingly Gold-Centric: Manappuram’s Q2 AUM growth was robust, with gold loans (GL) being the primary growth driver (+6% QoQ), with its mix improving to 83% in the consol.
Customer acquisition momentum remained healthy, with the company adding 3.15 Lc new customers during the quarter, taking its outstanding customer base to 27.2 Lc, up 12/3% YoY/QoQ.

Importantly, growth remained resilient despite some moderation in gold prices from recent peaks, indicating that demand is being supported by both elevated collateral values and underlying customer requirements.
valuation: Result Update 13th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 400 Manappuram Finance Ltd.
While the pace of additions in H1 has been modest, management remains confident of achieving its branch addition target.
Current Valuation: 1.7x Sep’28E ABV; Earlier Valuation: 1.9x FY28E ABV Current TP: Rs 400/share; Earlier TP: Rs 415/share Recommendation: We maintain our BUY recommendation on the stock.
watch: Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook: Manappuram’s near-term growth trajectory is expected to remain anchored by the gold loan franchise, with customer additions, digital sourcing and the planned branch expansion providing support to the guided 25-30% FY27 AUM growth.
